bundesliga|2026-10-19.text: Bayern München's 6-1 win over RB Leipzig was the biggest margin of the recent Bundesliga results. There were two draws: Union Berlin and Borussia Dortmund finished 0-0, while Werder Bremen and SC Paderborn played out a 2-2.
bundesliga|2026-10-19.name: Bundesliga

champions_league|2026-10-19.text: Aston Villa FC recorded the biggest margin of the recent Champions League results with a 6-0 win over Fenerbahce, while Liverpool FC beat LASK Linz 3-6 and FC Barcelona won 1-4 at Galatasaray. The only draw was Viking FK 3-3 FC Bayern München.
champions_league|2026-10-19.name: Champions League

conference_league|2026-10-19.text: Brighton & Hove Albion FC recorded the biggest margin of the recent Conference League results with a 4-0 win over Kauno Zalgiris. Four matches ended level: CSU Craiova 1-1 Getafe CF, Egnatia 1-1 FC Midtjylland, Heart of Midlothian 1-1 FC Nordsjælland, and Riga FC 1-1 Kairat Almaty.
conference_league|2026-10-19.name: Conference League

eredivisie|2026-10-19.text: Heerenveen's 4-0 win over Excelsior was the biggest margin of the recent Eredivisie round. There were two draws, with SC Cambuur and AZ Alkmaar finishing 2-2 and NEC Nijmegen and Fortuna Sittard also drawing 2-2.
eredivisie|2026-10-19.name: Eredivisie

europa_league|2026-10-19.text: The biggest margin of the recent Europa League results was a 4-0 win, with Bayer 04 Leverkusen beating Lech Poznan and AC Milan defeating RB Salzburg by that score. There were three draws: NEC Nijmegen 1-1 Levski Sofia, Sparta Prague 1-1 Lillestrom, and Union St.-Gilloise 1-1 Real Sociedad de Fútbol.
europa_league|2026-10-19.name: Europa League

la_liga|2026-10-19.text: Recent La Liga action featured several draws, including Levante UD 3-3 Sevilla FC, RC Deportivo La Coruña 1-1 Levante UD, Villarreal CF 0-0 Elche CF, and Valencia CF 0-0 Athletic Club. The biggest margin of the week came in Real Betis Balompié 2-5 FC Barcelona and Málaga CF 2-5 Real Sociedad de Fútbol.
la_liga|2026-10-19.name: La Liga

ligue_1|2026-10-19.text: Recent Ligue 1 results saw Angers SCO lose 2-5 to Olympique de Marseille, the biggest margin of the round. Draws included Lille OSC 1-1 Stade Brestois 29, while Paris FC edged Stade Rennais FC 1901 4-3.
ligue_1|2026-10-19.name: Ligue 1

premier_league|2026-10-19.text: Brighton & Hove Albion FC recorded the biggest margin of the recent Premier League results with a 5-0 win over Crystal Palace FC. Leeds United FC and Manchester United FC played out a 1-1 draw, the only draw in the set.
premier_league|2026-10-19.name: Premier League

primeira_liga|2026-10-19.text: In the only recent Primeira Liga result, Alverca beat FC Famalicao 4-1, the biggest margin among the listed matches. There were no draws in this set of results.
primeira_liga|2026-10-19.name: Primeira Liga

serie_a|2026-10-19.text: Recent Serie A results saw Frosinone Calcio beat US Sassuolo Calcio 4-2 for the biggest margin, while Udinese Calcio lost 0-3 to US Lecce and Juventus FC fell 0-3 to SS Lazio. There were no draws in the listed matches.
serie_a|2026-10-19.name: Serie A

super_lig|2026-10-19.text: Eyupspor 0-4 Goztepe was the biggest margin of the recent Süper Lig results. There were no draws in the listed matches.
super_lig|2026-10-19.name: Süper Lig
